ngaap.guidance: Q3-26: core revenue growth +2.0% to +3.0% (Biotech +MSD, Life Sciences +3-4%, Diagnostics flat; respiratory impact +2.5pt; core ex-respiratory ~+5.0%); FX ~(1.0)% on sales; amortization ~$(500)m; corporate expense ~$(90)m; net interest expense ~$(115)m; tax rate ~17.0%; adjusted diluted shares ~707m. Q4-26: core +MSD (respiratory flat). FY2026: core revenue growth +3.0% to +4.0% (Biotech +MSD, Life Sciences +3-4%, Diagnostics up slightly; respiratory impact +LSD; core ex-respiratory +MSD); adjusted diluted EPS raised to $8.45-$8.60 (from $8.35-$8.55); adjusted operating profit margin ~26.5%; FX ~+0.5% on sales; amortization ~$(1,900)m; corporate expense ~$(360)m; net interest expense ~$(310)m; tax rate ~17.0%; adjusted diluted shares ~709m. Respiratory testing sales ~$500m Q3-26, ~$1,600m FY26. Pending StatLab acquisition (~$250m 2025 revenue, Leica Biosystems / Diagnostics), expected to close by end-2026.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, fair value gains/losses on equity & LP investments, Masimo acquisition-related items, impairments, product-line disposition gains, and discrete tax items; no MCPS (converted 2022/2023). New non-GAAP measure from this quarter: core sales growth excluding respiratory testing; from Q3-26 core sales will also exclude tariff refunds returned to customers. Item amounts from release footnotes.
